```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

# Read CoverM output
coverm <- read.delim("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/coverm_eerie/coverm_2018_ODNR1.tsv",
                     check.names = FALSE)

# Read GTDB-Tk summary
gtdb <- read.delim("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output/65MAGs/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
                   check.names = FALSE)

# Look at column names
names(coverm)
names(gtdb)
```


```{r}

# Clean GTDB taxonomy
gtdb_clean <- gtdb %>%
  select(user_genome, classification) %>%
  separate(
    classification,
    into = c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order",
             "family", "genus", "species"),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(domain:species, ~ sub("^[a-z]__", "", .))
  )

# Clean CoverM output
coverm_clean <- coverm %>%
  filter(Genome != "unmapped") %>%
  rename(
    mean_coverage =
      `140938_GGAGGAAT-GAACGGTT_S17_R1_001.fastq Mean`,
    covered_fraction =
      `140938_GGAGGAAT-GAACGGTT_S17_R1_001.fastq Covered Fraction`,
    relative_abundance =
      `140938_GGAGGAAT-GAACGGTT_S17_R1_001.fastq Relative Abundance (%)`
  )

# Merge taxonomy and recruitment
ODNR1 <- coverm_clean %>%
  left_join(
    gtdb_clean,
    by = c("Genome" = "user_genome")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_genome_covered = covered_fraction * 100
  ) %>%
  select(
    Genome,
    genus,
    species,
    percent_genome_covered,
    mean_coverage,
    relative_abundance,
    phylum,
    class,
    order,
    family
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_genome_covered))

View(ODNR1)
```


```{r}
ODNR1 %>%
  select(
    Genome,
    genus,
    species,
    percent_genome_covered,
    mean_coverage,
    relative_abundance
  ) %>%
  print(row.names = FALSE)
```



```{r}
# Read and clean ODNR4
ODNR4_raw <- read.delim(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/coverm_eerie/coverm_2017_ODNR4.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

names(ODNR4_raw)[2:4] <- c(
  "mean_coverage",
  "relative_abundance",
  "covered_fraction"
)

ODNR4 <- ODNR4_raw %>%
  filter(Genome != "unmapped") %>%
  left_join(
    gtdb_clean,
    by = c("Genome" = "user_genome")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_genome_covered = covered_fraction * 100
  )
```


```{r}
# Combine 2017 and 2018 DNA recruitment
dna_plot <- bind_rows(
  
  ODNR4 %>%
    transmute(
      Genome,
      genus,
      species,
      sample = "2017",
      percent_genome_covered
    ),
  
  ODNR1 %>%
    transmute(
      Genome,
      genus,
      species,
      sample = "2018",
      percent_genome_covered
    )
)  %>%
  mutate(
    genus = if_else(
      is.na(genus) | trimws(genus) == "",
      "f__CAISDR01",
      genus
    )
  )
```



```{r}

# Make labels and order MAGs

dna_plot <- dna_plot %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = case_when(
      !is.na(species) & species != "" ~ species,
      !is.na(genus) & genus != "" ~ genus,
      TRUE ~ Genome
    )
  )

dna_plot <- dna_plot %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(taxon, " (", Genome, ")")
  )

mag_order <- dna_plot %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    max_breadth = max(percent_genome_covered),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(max_breadth) %>%
  pull(label)

dna_plot$label <- factor(
  dna_plot$label,
  levels = mag_order
)
```



```{r}
plot_wide <- dna_plot %>%
  select(
    Genome,
    genus,
    sample,
    percent_genome_covered
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = percent_genome_covered
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_breadth = pmax(`2017`, `2018`, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

plot_wide <- plot_wide %>%
  arrange(genus, desc(max_breadth)) %>%
  mutate(
    Genome = factor(Genome, levels = rev(unique(Genome)))
  )

heat_dat <- plot_wide %>%
  select(Genome, genus, `2017`, `2018`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`2017`, `2018`),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "coverage"
  )

```



```{r}
# Calculate max coverage per MAG
plot_wide <- plot_wide %>%
  mutate(
    max_breadth = pmax(`2017`, `2018`, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Order genera by their most strongly recruited MAG
genus_order <- plot_wide %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(
    genus_max = max(max_breadth, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(genus_max)) %>%
  pull(genus)

# Apply genus order and then order MAGs within genus
plot_wide <- plot_wide %>%
  mutate(
    genus = factor(
      genus,
      levels = genus_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    genus,
    desc(max_breadth)
  )

# MAG order for plotting
mag_order <- plot_wide %>%
  pull(Genome)

plot_wide$Genome <- factor(
  plot_wide$Genome,
  levels = rev(mag_order)
)

heat_dat <- plot_wide %>%
  select(
    Genome,
    genus,
    `2017`,
    `2018`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`2017`, `2018`),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "coverage"
  )



```




```{r}
# DNA panel
p_dna <- ggplot(
  heat_dat,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = Genome,
    fill = coverage
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    width = 0.98,
    height = 0.98
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", coverage)),
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  
  facet_grid(
    genus ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#f7fbff",
      "#c6dbef",
      "#6baed6",
      "#2171b5",
      "#08306b"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 10, 25, 50, 100)),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    name = "Genome covered (%)"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    # Put genus strips on far left
    strip.placement = "outside",
    
    # THIS creates the genus "bars"
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey90",
      color = "grey60",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    
    # Horizontal genus names inside the bars
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      size = 8.5,
      face = "italic",
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(2, 5, 2, 5)
    ),
    
    # MAG labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 8,
      margin = margin(r = 3)
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    
    # Small but visible space separating genera
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.10, "lines"),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.4, "cm"),
    
    plot.margin = margin(3, 2, 2, 2)
  )

p_dna
```


```{r}
ggsave(
  "MAG_environmental_recruitment.svg",
  p_dna,
  width = 8,
  height = 12,
  units = "in"
)
```
